turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Are you comfortable with how I am speaking?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Please talk a bit slower, my hearing is poor.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What brings you to the clinic today?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I came because of my chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: How would you describe what you feel in your chest?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is more of a dull ache.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it move into your arms or up toward your neck?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nowhere else.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did you first notice it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It came on slowly last night.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for it?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing really helps.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Will I have to stay in the hospital?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Not necessarily. We will decide after we see your test results.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does doing chores around the house set it off?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Only when I hurry.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you been sweating with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little sweaty, yes.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you feel winded along with the pain?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No trouble breathing at all.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you felt faint or dizzy?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any heart problems in your close relatives?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My brother had bypass surgery.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have any history of diabetes, blood pressure problems or cholesterol problems, or do you smoke?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have diabetes. I have never smoked.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you have a history of heart surgery or stents?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, a stent, a long time ago.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What are you taking at home for your health?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Clopidogrel and Metformin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Let us wrap up with the plan. First, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Second, bring your medicine bottles to your next visit. Can you repeat the plan in your own words for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will get the heart tracing and the blood test today and bring my medicine bottles next time.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Anything else on your mind?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Nothing else, thank you.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Okay, that is everything for today. Take care.
